title: The 2026 Annual Urhobo Progress Union America Convention
author: National Secretariat
excerpt: The 33rd Annual UPUA National Convention convenes at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, bringing together diaspora delegates, traditional rulers, and cultural ambassadors from across North America.
content: The National Executive Committee of the Urhobo Progress Union America is pleased to announce that the 33rd Annual National Convention and Cultural Gala will be held from September 3–7, 2026 at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel in Lawrenceburg, Indiana.
Hosted by UPU Ohio, this five-day landmark gathering brings together chapter delegates, respected royal fathers from Urhoboland, business executives, youth leaders, and cultural dance troupes.
Sessions will encompass plenary assembly deliberations, youth mentorship workshops, the inaugural Convention Golf Outing, and the Grand Cultural Gala Banquet on Saturday, September 5.
Hotel reservations and delegate passes are now open through the UPUA portal and official ticket store.

title: UPU America medical outreach at the 2023 UPU Worldwide Conference
author: Medical Outreach Directorate
excerpt: A dedicated volunteer medical team dispatched by UPUA provided free health screenings, medications, optical consultations, and preventive healthcare packages to hundreds of community members in Urhoboland.
content: As part of our commitment to homeland health and wellness, UPUA successfully executed a comprehensive community medical outreach mission during the UPU Worldwide Conference.

Volunteer doctors, nurses, and pharmacists conducted screenings for hypertension, diabetes, and vision impairments, dispensing free medications and distributing over 500 prescription eyeglasses to elderly and low-income residents.
Community leaders in Delta State expressed immense gratitude to the diaspora for consistently investing in the grassroots health and vitality of our people.

title: Science, Technology, Engineering & Mathematics (STEM), Artificial Intelligence (AI) Training in Urhoboland
author: UPUAYA Youth & Tech Committee
excerpt: Over 1,200 secondary and tertiary students across Urhoboland participated in intensive coding, machine learning, and digital innovation bootcamps sponsored by UPU America.
content: Bridging the global digital divide, UPU America and the UPUAYA Youth Wing completed a landmark STEM & Artificial Intelligence training program for youth in Delta State.

Participants engaged in hands-on workshops covering web application development, cloud computing, and real-world AI applications designed to solve local challenges in agriculture, healthcare, and education.
Top student projects were awarded scholarships and remote technical mentorship from senior diaspora software engineers.

title: UPU America donation to the Okama IDPs
author: UPUA Welfare Directorate
excerpt: Emergency humanitarian relief packages, food staples, clean water supplies, and bedding delivered to internally displaced families following regional disruptions.
content: Demonstrating steadfast brotherhood in times of adversity, UPUA mobilized emergency relief supplies for internally displaced persons (IDPs) in the Okuama community.
Chapter donations across North America funded bulk purchases of rice, grain, medical first-aid kits, blankets, and temporary shelter equipment delivered directly by accredited ground coordinators.
National leadership reaffirmed that UPUA will continue to advocate for peaceful rehabilitation and resettlement for all affected families.
